newsitem.title: USA: Harcourt extends National shares offer.
newsitem.headline: Harcourt extends National shares offer.

text.p: Harcourt General Inc said Wednesday it has acquired 84.2 percent of National Education Corp's outstanding common stock in its cash tender offer connected with the merger of the two companies.

Harcourt, a textbook publishing company, said it has extended the deadline for National Education shareholders to tender their holdings at $21 per share until 1700 EDT/2100 GMT, June 4. The offer was to expire Tuesday.

In a related move, Steck-Vaughn Publishing Corp said Wednesday it has postponed indefinitely its annual stockholders meeting because of the pending merger between Harcourt and National Education. National Education owns about 83 percent of Steck-Vaughn's stock and has announced plans to acquire the remaining 17 percent upon completion of the Harcourt merger, Steck-Vaughn said.
The Steck-Vaughn meeting had been scheduled for Thursday, May 28, it said. A new date will be announced later.
